meta.name: tool-calling-tutor
meta.description: Use when a tool-calling agent does not call a tool, sends wrong arguments, loops without stopping, or needs a function schema. Guides a four-branch diagnosis and five-step schema repair. Do not use for framework-specific, MCP-server, or production-observability questions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定位AI不调用工具或卡死循环的根因并修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发AI智能体,且常遇到工具调用出错或卡循环。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix AI agent tool-calling failures and loops.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build AI agents and often see tool-calling errors or endless loops.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 变成 tool-calling 调试助手:先让你从四种症状中选一个,再按对应分支带你排查——tool 不被呼叫、参数错、ReAct loop 跑不停,或从零设计 schema。它只做诊断和改法指引,不替你写整份代码。
howto.when: 当你做 tool-calling agent 卡住时接管:模型不呼叫工具、参数不对、多步 loop 循环等。它不处理 framework、MCP server、生产监控类问题。

say.text: 我的 LLM 不肯呼叫我的 tool，帮我看看
say.note: 它会先问你属于哪种症状

say.text: tool 被呼叫了但参数不对，帮我改 parameters schema
我要从零设计一个 function schema，带我做那 5 步

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a tool-calling debugger: you pick one of four symptoms (tool not called, wrong args, runaway loop, no schema yet) and it walks the matching branch, pointing to fixes rather than writing code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you're stuck building a tool-calling agent: the model won't call your tool, sends wrong args, or the loop won't stop, etc. Not for framework, MCP-server, or observability questions.

say_en.text: My LLM won't call my tool — help me debug it
say_en.note: It asks the 4-symptom triage question first

say_en.text: The tool gets called but the arguments are wrong — fix my schema
